sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant expresses his helplessness to comply the office objections due to non- accessibility of the appellant despite his sincere efforts.

2. Under the above circumstances, when the appellant is said to have been not co-operating with the learned counsel to do the needful in the matter, there is NC: 2024:KHC:2233-DB no point in granting further time, as such, the appeal stands dismissed for non-compliance of office objections and for non-prosecution.
